marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead sase-1le.3 is done and closed.

What landed (floor branch, per the epic decisions):

- **Single-sourced install command** — new `tools/render_applicability` owns `INSTALL_COMMAND = 'uv tool install "sase>=0.18"'`, with `--install-command` (read by the smoke workflow), `--check-installed` (asserts `sase version -j` meets the floor), and `--check` (verifies the generated partial plus command containment in all five docs). Applied the floor to every copy-pasteable install fence in `README.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `docs/getting_started.md`, `docs/plugins.md`, and `docs/rust_backend.md`.
- **Release line** — dismissible Material announce banner via `docs/overrides/main.html` plus `announce.dismiss`, rendered from `.release-please-manifest.json` into a generated partial. Since the manifest reads 0.17.1 (below the floor), it truthfully says "v0.18 pending — the documented install is not yet released". Hidden from the handbook PDF via the `extra.pdf_handbook` guard.
- **Scheduled smoke** — new `.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml` (daily cron + dispatch): runs the single-sourced command on clean Ubuntu, asserts the floor, then `sase --help` and `sase doctor -j` (warnings tolerated, hard errors fail).
- **Drift check + tests** — wired into `fmt-docs`/`fmt-docs-check`; new `tests/test_render_applicability.py` (7 tests).

Verification: strict docs build green with the banner confirmed in the rendered HTML; PyPI resolution checked live — max available is 0.17.1, so the floor command fails loudly (`only sase<=0.17.1 is available`) instead of silently installing 0.1.0, and the smoke will report that red until 0.18 ships. Full `just check`: all lint stages and 55,905 scoped tests passed except one sandbox test broken by my new Justfile line — root-caused, sandbox extended, all 22 tests in both affected files green on re-run. No epic-symbol entries. Two follow-ups recorded on the bead as notes (dated blog-post fences; a pre-existing `doctor` macro error in this checkout). Final declaration accepted with `bead_action: close`.
